scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:server
scripts.package:artifact: pnpm run build && node server/prepare-runtime-package.js && pnpm install --prod --dir dist --ignore-scripts --no-frozen-lockfile
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:agents && pnpm run lint
scripts.test:api: node --import tsx --test src/api/resources.test.ts src/api/auth.test.ts src/api/stream.test.ts src/hooks/useAsyncResource.test.tsx src/entry-server.test.tsx server/portfolio-content.test.js server/app.test.js server/artifact.test.js server/route-data.test.js server/build-html.test.js server/sitemap.test.js
